items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Honey Hancock was playing us on the radio station that he was on. Remember Honey Hancock?

ctx.x: find records for people. Anyway, he would be on the scene and he was a real music lover -- and he knew all of the solos on all of the records. All the latest records, he knew them. Like, at the jam sessions he'd be like the cheerleader, you know. [LAUGHS] He'd be pulling for his man, you know, leading the applause and everything. He was the kind of... I called it "R.V.'s Wig," because he had a fierce hairdo, a ...(?). and everything. And this was like in the middle Forties and in the early Fifties, through that…
Anyway, I did this date, and we got pretty good exposure. Honey Hancock was playing us on the radio station that he was on. Remember Honey Hancock?
